newsitem.title: USA: Forest City files $250 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Forest City files $250 mln shelf.

text.p: Forest City Entperises Inc filed Tuesday a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $250 million subordinated debt securities and preferred and Class A common stock.

Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include repayment of indebtedness, additions to working capital, capital expenditures and acquisitions or for such other purposes as the company specifies.

Forest City, based in Cleveland, Ohio, is a real estate company principally engaged in the development, construction, ownership and management of commercial and residential real estate throughout the United States.
